main_text.p: resceret, dissecari: Ha nimis fero corde! Xerxes etiam immanis ille κύκλωπ⁠ς, qui maria pedibus & classibus montes peragravit, eodem Genio in similem actus est furorem: Nam, cum Helle-Xerxem in Helle-spontum.spontū contabulasset,& Asiæ Europam ponte junxisset;hic vero fluctibus insurgens, sto-lidam illam compagem excussisset, ruinasque ejus inter undas suas volveret, trecentos mari colaphos infringi jussit, ferreas etiam compedes, ne qua liberè vagaretur, sed arctis intra litora sua carceribus detineretur, injecit. Mussitat Pantomimus, nictat oculis, nutat capite, gesticulatur.

page.notes: The Greek word "κύκλωψ" is printed with a letter form that is partly uncertain; the last line ends in "latui" with a cut-off word ("gesticu-latur" continues at the line end, the final syllable is cropped at the page edge). Left margin note "Xerxem in Hellespontum" is printed in small italic type. Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible at the right and is not transcribed.
